scripts.text: That's right, I'm waiting for a strong adventurer to satisfy my curiosity!
scripts.translation: 沒錯，我在等一位強大的冒險者來滿足我的好奇心！

scripts.text: If you reach level 175, you will be my destined opponent-��
scripts.translation: 只要你達到175級，就會成為我命中註定的對手-��

scripts.text: I think I've made a great discovery, so why don't you come with me?
scripts.translation: 我有了重大發現，要不要跟我一起去看看？

scripts.text: You're gonna jump into the abyss with me! I can't help But L-O-V-E you.
scripts.translation: 你要和我一起跳進深淵！我就是忍不住愛你。

scripts.text: As you know, I'm a good court wizard, right?
scripts.translation: 你知道的，我可是優秀的宮廷魔法師，對吧？

scripts.text: A genius wizard who can do this and that on dimension!
scripts.translation: 能在次元之間施展各種魔法的天才魔法師！

scripts.text: There was a report of strange magical power near central castle of Glast Heim.
scripts.translation: 有人報告說，古城葛拉斯特海姆中央城堡附近出現了奇異的魔力。

scripts.text: I came here to investigate and found it.
scripts.translation: 我來這裡調查，結果發現了它。

scripts.text: You know, this genius wizard is good at connecting the crack of dimensions.
scripts.translation: 你知道吧，我這個天才魔法師最擅長連線次元裂縫。

scripts.text: So I forced the connection and went in....
scripts.translation: 於是我強行連通裂縫，走了進去...

scripts.text: A piece of time that has stopped in the flow.... Hmmm... It's so hard to explain..
scripts.translation: 一段從時間洪流中停滯下來的時光...嗯...真難解釋...

scripts.text: Anyway, the flood of creatures trapped for a long time came to me like waves!
scripts.translation: 總之，長期被困在裡面的生物像潮水一樣向我湧來！

scripts.text: I almost D - i - e - d there.
So I'm looking for adventurers to join me on this expedition.
scripts.translation: 所以我正在招募冒險者，和我一起進行這次探險。

scripts.text: Right, there's no mission here, but curiosity follows discovery!
scripts.translation: 沒錯，這裡沒有什麼任務，發現新事物就會讓人好奇！

scripts.text: You noticed before I told you there were a few things I wanted to do with you, My - Darling -.
scripts.translation: 在我開口之前，你就發現我有幾件事想和你一起做了，我的——親愛的——。

scripts.text: A Thing with High Freezing Point
Beyond the cracks of this dimension, there are Empty Things..
scripts.translation: 穿過次元裂縫，裡面有一些空洞之物...
^0000FF汙染幽靈劍士^000000和^0000FF汙染幽靈弓箭手^000000...

scripts.text: ^0000FF20 Contaminated Raydric Archers^000000!! Defeat them and come back. Then this genius wizard will study it.
scripts.translation: 還有^0000FF20只汙染幽靈弓箭手^000000！！完成後回來，讓這位天才魔法師研究一下。

scripts.text: If you're busy, you can't help me.
scripts.translation: 如果你很忙，就沒法幫我了。

scripts.text: But honey, please help me when You - Have - Spare - Time - !
scripts.translation: 不過親愛的，有空的時候一定要幫我哦——！

scripts.text: I asked you too much today, Sweetie.
scripts.translation: 今天我拜託你的事情太多了，甜心。

scripts.text: Instead, you're sharing another new discovery tomorrow. O - K - A - Y -?
scripts.translation: 作為補償，明天再和我分享一個新發現。好——嗎——？

scripts.text: Um? That's to be a full-time employee!
scripts.translation: 嗯？這是要轉正的意思嗎！

scripts.text: Not long ago, I joined Regenschrum as a trainee researcher, but this is what I was appointed for.
scripts.translation: 不久前，我加入雷根舒爾姆成為實習研究員，沒想到就被指派了這項工作。

scripts.text: It's about collecting data on mining monsters, so my evaluation depends on that.
scripts.translation: 這是收集礦坑魔物的資料，我的考核就看這項成果了。

scripts.text: And there were constant complaints from the headquarters asking what to do with the mine monsters.
scripts.translation: 總部還不斷投訴，問我們打算怎麼處理礦坑魔物。

scripts.text: While collecting data, it also regulates the number of individuals. This evaluation is a win-win, a win-win!
scripts.translation: 一邊收集資料，一邊控制魔物數量。這次考核真是一舉兩得！

scripts.text: The orders keep pouring in, and everyone who works there is running away... It's a big deal, a big deal.
scripts.translation: 訂單一直湧進來，所有在這裡工作的人都逃跑了...這可不得了，真是大麻煩。

scripts.text: After all, it would be faster for me to learn the sword! I've only been picking a pickaxe for 10 years, so I'll learn it soon.
scripts.translation: 說到底，還不如讓我學劍更快！我拿了10年鎬子，很快就能學會用劍了。
